findings.detail: The single-GPU launcher reads _LAUNCHER['single_visible_dev'], but that key is never defined in either _LAUNCHER mapping (lines 109-116 and 127-135). On a one-GPU host without CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, automatic single-GPU mode raises KeyError before starting the trainer. The committed training log demonstrates the four-GPU path, not this path.
findings.reproduction: Run the script entry point with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES unset and torch.cuda.device_count() <= 1 (or invoke the helper with resolve_single_gpu() true); line 524 raises KeyError: 'single_visible_dev'.
findings.correction: Define single_visible_dev in _LAUNCHER or remove the lookup and preserve the inherited/default device visibility. Exercise the entry point in single-GPU mode as well as torchrun mode.
